title: ArchiveVolumeMeasuredPayload
description: Payload of the ArchiveVolumeMeasured event (INV-REQ-878; class: domain). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

tenantRef.description: The tenant that owns the entity. evidence-svc writes the canonical lower-case hyphenated text of the tenant id, which TenantRefs.idOf of tenancy-domain maps back to that id.

entityRef.description: The entity whose retained archive volume was measured.

bytes.description: The size in bytes of everything evidence-svc retains for the entity at measuredAt.

measuredAt.description: The instant the volume was measured.
